18.description: The committee recommends a $3.64 million project for one-way protected bike lanes and sidewalks on Victoria Avenue (Taylor to Ruth Street), increasing annual snow removal costs to $225,000.

chips.text: Councillor Pearce questioned a "field of dreams" mentality for bike lane usage.
Residents along Victoria Avenue (Taylor to Ruth) will lose on-street parking.
No specific data on winter bike traffic for this Victoria Avenue segment.
Adjacent residents were most likely to oppose cycling infrastructure improvements.
Councillor Pearce opposed due to low current usage and six-fold increase in snow removal costs.

19.description: A committee recommends creating a new limited residential parking zone across three blocks in Nutana East to manage parking congestion, allowing residents to purchase permits.

chips.text: Committee discussed cost recovery for parking zones and potential permit fee increases.
Residents on three blocks within the east side of the Nutana neighborhood.
Two resident petitions initiated the new limited residential parking zone.
Administration promised a broader review of the parking program by fall 2026.
